description: OpenViveksha node type registry. Each node type defines config fields (JSON Schema), ports, and execution semantics. Port types: TXT, PROMPT, TOOLS, ANY. EMBED, AUDIO, HARMONICS, SECURITY, FILES are reserved for future versions.

portTypes.PROMPT: A composed prompt object: { system, messages, tools? }. Produced by role/tools, consumed by llm/tools.
portTypes.TOOLS: Tool definitions from an MCP server (array of { name, description, inputSchema }).

nodeTypes.label: Input Channel
nodeTypes.summary: External trigger: webhook (HTTP POST with secret) or local webchat. Emits { message } on trigger.

secret.description: Shared secret; required header X-Ingress-Secret on webhook POST.

execute.outputs: When triggered: { message }. When a value arrives on `reply`, the channel may forward/deliver it (implementation-defined in v0.1: stored and visible via API).

nodeTypes.label: Role
nodeTypes.summary: Composes the system prompt (SOUL) for this agent from the incoming message. Produces a PROMPT for llm/tools.

mode.description: chat: conversational; generate: single-shot content generation.

systemPrompt.description: Optional extra system instructions appended to soulPrompt.

execute.outputs: { prompt: { system, messages } }. On the `reply` input: passes the reply through (loop back-edge delivery).

nodeTypes.label: LLM Provider
nodeTypes.summary: Calls an OpenAI-compatible or Ollama chat endpoint with the composed PROMPT. Returns { reply }.

maxTokens.description: Guideline: >= 8192 when the graph uses tool calls — smaller values truncate JSON tool arguments.

execute.outputs: { reply } — model text; when the prompt carries tools and the model returns tool_calls, tools nodes consume them.

nodeTypes.label: Tool Loop
nodeTypes.summary: Agentic tool loop: takes PROMPT + TOOLS, runs LLM <-> tool-call iterations until a final text reply or maxIterations.

inputs.name: reply
inputs.description: LLM reply passed through the loop (back-edge).

execute.outputs: Without tools input: passthrough prompt, reply passthrough. With tools: executes the tool loop (may invoke MCP tools), final { reply }.

nodeTypes.label: MCP Source
nodeTypes.summary: Connects to an MCP server (stdio or streamable HTTP) and emits its tool definitions on `tools`.

authToken.description: Optional bearer token sent as Authorization header (http).

execute.outputs: { tools: [ { name, description, inputSchema } ] } from the connected MCP server; empty when inactive/unreachable (never blocks the graph — see Laws §5).

nodeTypes.label: Conversation History
nodeTypes.summary: Memory passthrough: injects prior conversation turns into the prompt and records new turns. Gives an agent memory across runs (per session).

depth.description: How many recent turns to inject; 0 = all.

execute.outputs: On `prompt`: appends stored conversation turns, returns augmented prompt. On `reply`: records the assistant turn, passes the reply through.

nodeTypes.label: Chat / Output
nodeTypes.summary: Conversation entry/output node. Typically the run start (seeded with { message }) and the sink for the final reply.

execute.outputs: { message } — as start node it is seeded by the executor; otherwise forwards the incoming reply.
